meta.note_100: Insider Gaming counts 35 tasks on the 100% checklist; the requirements listed in A Long Road are the ones PowerPyx confirms. See the 100% tab for the confirmed list.

roadmap.name: Phase 1 — Story Run
roadmap.note: Chapters 1–5. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, scan vehicles and study animals as you go, and keep a save at each chapter's start and end.

roadmap.name: Phase 2 — 100% Sweep
roadmap.note: After the story: the checklist opens (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion). Clear the must-complete lines in full and the partial lines to their thresholds.

roadmap.name: Phase 3 — Strangers & Cleanup
roadmap.note: Stranger strands (not needed for 100%), quest-giver finals, one-off feats, and anything left on the tracker.

roadmap.name: Phase 4 — Platinum
roadmap.note: Vice Got a Price! pops with the 54th trophy.

meta.title: The Leonida Field Manual

rebuild.note: entry files rewritten from the prose spec; data content verified, not retyped

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are earned. No multiplayer, no DLC and no difficulty setting stand in the way: one playthrough, about 200 hours on PowerPyx's roadmap, and the whole list is single-player.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

steps.t: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.
Play on any difficulty — there is only one difficulty for everyone, and it does not affect trophies.
Plan one playthrough: story (60–80 h), then the 100% sweep (~100 h), then strangers and cleanup (~10 h).

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing — the first mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

steps.t: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end.
The trophy pops when the mission completes; no extra objective is needed.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. PowerPyx notes it actually pops after the first main mission of Chapter 2, 'What's in the Bag?' — so keep playing one mission past the chapter's end.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission.
Start Chapter 2 and complete its first main mission, What's in the Bag? — the trophy pops there.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before leaving the chapter (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Per PowerPyx it pops after the first main mission of Chapter 3, 'Welcome to Vice City'. Chapter 2 is also where both-character play unlocks (after Coffee Break).
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission.
Start Chapter 3 and complete Welcome to Vice City — the trophy pops there.
From Coffee Break onward you can switch between Jason and Lucia and free-roam together.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. PowerPyx notes it pops after the first two main missions of Chapter 4, 'Ocean Beach' and 'Another Life'. Chapter 3 unlocks the Key Cloner, Yasmani's jewelry jobs and Payday Loans robberies.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission.
Start Chapter 4 and complete Ocean Beach and Another Life — the trophy pops there.
Pick up the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS) and Yasmani's jobs while in Chapter 3; they unlock later trophies.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. Per PowerPyx it pops after the final main mission of Chapter 4, 'Starting From Zero' — the same mission that pops the gold final-mission trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

steps.t: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission, through Starting From Zero.
The trophy pops with the mission; the gold final-mission trophy pops at the same point.

trophies.guide: Gold story trophy for the final mission. PowerPyx maps the final mission to 'Starting From Zero'; Beebom and CULTR word it as a Chapter 5 mission (see dispute D9). Either way it is automatic: finish the story and it pops.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

steps.t: Play the story through to its final mission, Starting From Zero.
The trophy pops when the final mission completes; there is no mission replay, so keep a save at the end of each chapter.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Trust

steps.t: Play the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run to its end.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

steps.t: Play the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist to its end.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Family Matters

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play to its end.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners to its end.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

steps.t: Play the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown to its end.

trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy. Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. It cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

steps.t: Play the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory to its end.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy and the long pole of the platinum: reach 100% on the in-game checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), which only opens after the story. The good news is the checklist is lenient — PowerPyx puts it near 60% true completion — and nothing on it is missable. Most of it is partial credit: 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations. Only a few lines need everything: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests.
trophies.name: A Long Road

steps.t: Finish the story first; the checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion. Progress made during the story already counts.
Complete any 100 optional missions (there are 200–300+; purple icons and black icons with pink letters). Each Moses/Randy vehicle delivery counts too.
Scan any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — boats and aircraft included. Start early and it finishes naturally.
Study any 100 of 255 animals through the binoculars (L1 to select, Up to zoom, hold R1 to study). Every breed of dog and cat counts separately; no hunting needed.
Complete any 70 of 80 challenges, 300 of 397 stunts, and 15 of 18 meditations — pick the easiest in each set.
Clear the must-complete lines in full: all robberies, all underwater discoveries, all shooting ranges, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks.

trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the game's 397 stunts, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. PowerPyx calls the bridge flights the quickest. Track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and by name on the map (Exploration > Stunt Spots). The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

steps.t: Do any 250 stunts across the four types — they mix freely toward the total.
Fastest route: fly under bridges (202 available). Stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps fill the rest.
Track progress by region (Progress > Activities > Stunts, R3) and by name on the map (Exploration > Stunt Spots).
Keep going to 300 stunts — the 100% checklist needs them.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (scoring hoops), playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt. PowerPyx says you will do one of each automatically while working on the other trophies. Check the counter under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.
trophies.name: Master of None

steps.t: Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball hoops, a video game, a race win, a stunt.
Find activities on the map via the Activities filter (blue dumbbell icons).
Check what is left under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; it shows a count per type.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. PowerPyx's dedicated guide maps every range and gold-medal target; the medals are not very difficult, and ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
trophies.name: The Shootist

steps.t: Visit all 12 shooting ranges and gold-medal every challenge — 42 in total.
Use PowerPyx's range guide for each range's layout and gold target.
Ranges also build Focus (needed for Gunslinger), so do them before chasing that trophy.

trophies.countLabel: Top Fun locations won (42 races total)
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total). PowerPyx's location guide covers every race. Drone races are also a must-complete line for 100%, so win them all rather than one per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun

steps.t: Win a drone race at each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
Win all 42 races — the 100% checklist needs every drone race done.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races from the 40 unique race locations. Any race type counts; PowerPyx's race-location guide lists all 40. A race win also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

steps.t: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count twice.
Use PowerPyx's guide to the 40 unique race locations and pick the easiest 20.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. After the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento. Go there and win the challenge. Fishing also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), then wait for Cal's text.
Go to the purple-marked fishing spot west of Key Lento and beat Cal in the challenge.

trophies.guide: Complete one of the 4 arcade games (called 'Video Games' in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck. The first three play on the TV at home (interact with the controllers) from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. 'Complete' means finishing all levels once — no need to beat every challenge. Playing a video game also ticks one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

steps.t: Pick one of the 4 video games and play it to the end of its levels.
Easiest: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV at home, available from Chapter 1.
You do not need to beat all challenges — reaching the end once is enough.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest optional line — Lucia only. During Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, Andy calls and then texts her home address, marking the line in Belville. All quests stay available after the story. TechWiser (via EGamers) notes story-linked windows on stranger chains, but PowerPyx says all trophy quest givers remain available after the story (see dispute D8).
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

steps.t: In Chapter 3 as Lucia, take Andy's call and follow her text to Belville.

Complete the 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
The trophy pops on the final mission, Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: clear 7 shipwrecks and bring the treasures back. Kenton marks automatically in Chapter 1 (green 'KR' icon, Key Lento) after the mission Island Dreams. Watch the gap: Kenton goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2–3 — PowerPyx says you can speed his return by calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2. Track under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

steps.t: After Island Dreams (Chapter 1), take Kenton's call and visit his shop at the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Clear shipwrecks: follow the purple treasure-chest icons, dive, and use the metal detector to dig up treasure from the ocean floor.
Turn in each set; Kenton calls back with more locations until all 7 shipwrecks are cleared.
If Kenton goes quiet after Chapter 1, wait for Chapters 2–3 or call Brian as Jason to bring his objectives back.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County. It marks automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. All quests stay available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

steps.t: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), go to the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County.
Complete the 5 Billy quests: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes.
The trophy pops on the final mission, Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. The catch: many optional lines do NOT count — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are not 'strangers' for this trophy. PowerPyx confirms 4 that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete) and says more are still being discovered (see dispute D6). All strangers are still findable after the story; check your count in the PSN trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

steps.t: Do the 4 confirmed strands first: Kirk (Skunk Ape / Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing), Pilot Pete (deliveries).
Keep clearing stranger questlines until the PSN tracker hits 8 — more qualifying strands are still being confirmed.
Do not count Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie lines toward this trophy; the game does not.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List. The line opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), which also unlocks the Key Cloner. Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; Randy marks some cars in fixed spots, and you can steal others off the street — scan with the WAiNK app to check a car against the list, then deliver it to his garage (green 'RK' icon, west Vice City) in good condition for better pay. Cars spawn often around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

steps.t: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List.

Deliver all 16: Zorrusso (done in the mission), Vitello, Infernus, Windsor Drop, Toros, Tempesta, Paragon, Jagular, Jubilee, Itali RSX, Growler, Gauntlet Hellfire, Furia, Dubsta, Banshee, Baller ST-D.
Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to check them against the list; deliver in good condition for more money.
Check off progress under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's line — Jason only. After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs around Vice City; destroy them as part of 'Take Out Kitty Litter'. Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone gives his second quest, 'Spin On This' (Shut Down the Labs), which pops the trophy. Still available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

steps.t: As Jason, finish Here, Kitty Kitty (Chapter 3) to mark the Synthetic Labs.
Destroy the labs in the Take Out Kitty Litter quest.
Take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) — the trophy pops there.

trophies.countLabel: meditations (10 spots; both characters count twice)
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONLY POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at every spot: 18 meditations across 10 locations — both characters at a spot counts +2. The risk is the first meditation, Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house in Chapter 1: after Down to Earth, talk to her in the kitchen in the morning, follow her out and choose 'Accept'. It is gone after Chapter 1, and no source has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — PowerPyx's author did it and earned the trophy, so do it. The last meditation needs both characters together (after Coffee Break, Chapter 2).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

steps.t: CHAPTER 1 — DO NOT SKIP: after Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and Accept the meditation.
Make a manual save right after the Chapter 1 meditation (15 manual slots; keep one per chapter start/end).
Meditate at the remaining spots with BOTH Jason and Lucia — each spot counts twice, once per character.
The final meditation needs both characters together; it unlocks after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track the counter under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the target is 18.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel — Jason only. After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), Bret texts Jason and marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons; bring the animals he requests back to him. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still unconfirmed (see dispute D5) — work the line and clear his 15 Target Decks (all needed for 100% anyway). Bret gives you the unique hunting rifle 'Killtelligence SM-69' in his first quest; one clean shot leaves a pristine kill and pays more. Track under Map > Activities > Target Deck.
trophies.name: Fair Game

steps.t: As Jason, after Coffee Break, take Bret's text and meet him at Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals Bret requests at the purple-marked spots and bring them to him.
Clear all 15 Target Decks — they are required for 100% and the trophy is expected along the way.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. PowerPyx's card guide maps every set's locations. You only need 3, so pick the sets whose cards cluster closest together.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

steps.t: Collect cards until 3 full sets are complete — any 3 of the 18 count.
Use PowerPyx's guide to all 18 card set locations to plan the shortest routes.

trophies.countLabel: WAiNK scans (31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, tags)
trophies.guide: WAiNK-scan 100 locations: hold Up then R1 while looking at a scannable object. There are more than 100 — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — so any 100 count. The same app scans vehicles for Whip It Good and the 100% checklist, so scan everything you pass.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

steps.t: Hold Up then R1 to WAiNK-scan objects in the world; any 100 count.
Prioritise landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) — PowerPyx lists them all.
Scan vehicles with the same app: it counts toward Whip It Good and the 100% vehicle line.

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges (eight groups of ten). The 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way — leave it for late, pick the easiest remaining ones, and track them under Progress > Challenges (the checkmark in the bottom-right of each challenge shows completion).
trophies.name: One Last Thing

steps.t: Complete any 50 of 80 challenges — skip the hardest; there are 10 more than the 100% checklist needs.
Leave this for late: many challenges finish naturally while working on other trophies.
Track under Progress > Challenges; then push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, and escape the heat zone. Earliest is after Coffee Break (Chapter 2), when you can free-roam together — call your partner with Right + Triangle. PowerPyx's easiest escape: drive through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County), where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. The trophy pops when you drive out of the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area. It also pops naturally during the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' and its bank-vault robberies, which always bring 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

steps.t: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle).
Cause carnage until you reach 4 stars, then escape — a fast sports motorcycle cuts through traffic; shoot at a chasing helicopter to shake it.
Easiest route: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone — keep driving until it clears.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Available after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level (not the red heat level) — loot a couple of items per shop and crack the back-room safe with sticky bombs. PowerPyx's spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3). The pop is delayed ~30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if it does not pop, hit a 4th. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation) and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

steps.t: After Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle) and gear up: armored vest, sticky bombs, healing.
Rob 3 shops in a row without losing the wanted level — loot items and break each back-room safe.
Best spot: the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, Chapter 3).
Wait ~30 seconds after the 3rd shop; if it has not popped, rob a 4th and keep going.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles from the 557 at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes). Just scan them with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — you do not need to drive them. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops on the way. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

steps.t: Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1) — scanning is enough, no driving needed.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic until you hit 100.
Keep scanning to 200 base models — the 100% checklist needs them.

trophies.countLabel: enemies downed in one Combat Focus
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming — time slows and weak spots highlight). It only lasts a few seconds, so buff first: eat/drink or wash up at home, take Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor, and use a full-auto assault rifle like the Duke 556. Line up 5 criminals at a Gang Operation and do not miss. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. It gets easier as Focus levels up (4 levels — shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots raise it); PowerPyx expects most players to reach Focus Level 4 naturally and earn this along the way.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

steps.t: Raise Focus first: shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing, headshots — check it under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus.
Buff before the attempt: food/drink, wash up at home, Adrenaline to extend Combat Focus, body armor on.
Find 5 criminals together at a Gang Operation; trigger Combat Focus (L3 + R3 while aiming) and down all 5 with an assault rifle.
Do not try it on soldiers, police or civilians — it does not seem to count on them.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked to a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane on the airfield. Easiest is the plane at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to board, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse to the airstrip, take off and fly 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

steps.t: Go to VCIA and target the docked passenger plane at terminals E3/E4 (boarding bridge connected).
Drive through an airfield fence, take the stairs by the boarding bridge into the plane, then upstairs to the cockpit.
Reverse the plane to the airstrip, take off, and fly at least 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand in the south of the base: drive through the gate (or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance), climb in, and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

steps.t: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, south-west edge of the map, Mariana County.
Enter the base (gate, or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance) and find the tanks in the south.
Climb into a Rhino and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without being detected. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun (silent lockpick for alarmed doors) and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Enter through the backdoor with the Snap Gun (kicking the door trips the alarm), find the safe-code note in the backroom, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm. The trophy pops shortly after you leave. PowerPyx's suggested spot: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

steps.t: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) to unlock the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies.
Enter a jewelry store through its backdoor with the Snap Gun — never kick the door.
In the backroom, read the safe-code note, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave undetected; the trophy pops shortly after you exit.

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, from the 8 large bank jobs in the game. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' (Wait at the Cafe) — it teaches the method and counts as your first vault: tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the vault is open, and bring your partner to hand off a cash bag (hold Right). Afterward, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (after his earlier quests, including 2 Payday Loans robberies) to mark vans with purple icons. Every vault robbery brings an instant 4-star wanted level — escape on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to go unrecognised. The 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — it unlocks vault robberies and counts as vault 1.
Tail security vans to banks (buy Yasmani's $10,000 tips after his quests) and rob the vault while it is open — bring your partner to carry a bag.
Escape the instant 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles.
Rob any 5 for the trophy; all 8 are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…' — tailing the security van to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier method: block an armored truck driving near banks in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs come from the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests). Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius — or use a Pay 'n' Spray.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

steps.t: Easiest: do the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… — the vault robbery counts as an armored truck robbery.
Earlier: block an armored truck near a bank, sticky-bomb its back door, and loot it.
Escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) — the trophy pops on the escape, not the robbery.

trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the whole map is visible. PowerPyx's unfog guide names the best plane for the job. Exploring also marks activities, ranges and shops for other trophies.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

steps.t: Get a plane and fly over every fogged area until the map is fully visible — 52 areas in total.
Use PowerPyx's unfog guide for the best plane and route.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them — so this pops on the way. Operations show as yellow icons when you go near them, and many mark automatically from story progress. Track per gang under Progress > Gangs (bottom-right shows how many of each gang's operations you have robbed).
trophies.name: Pest Control

steps.t: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — yellow map icons near the sites.
Track per gang under Progress > Gangs.
Clear all 39 operations — the 100% checklist needs them.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, buy an Apple Martini, and drink it while standing next to the bar. The trophy pops as you drink with the view. It is hidden on PSN despite being a simple one-off.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

steps.t: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window — a GTA III easter egg. You need the Key Cloner first (Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs). Hack into the car, drive forward through the window; the pop is slightly delayed and comes once you are out on the street. Only this specific blue Banshee counts.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

steps.t: Get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Go to the showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive straight through the showroom window and keep driving — the trophy pops on the street.

trophies.countLabel: key valuables stolen at Kingpin Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — one of the gang operations, and the site of the Chapter 2 optional mission 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (it marks automatically in Chapter 2). Buy sticky bombs first (Ammu-Nation) for the safe. The three items: the luxury watch in the south-east office (golden icon), the unique shotgun 'Gutterball Moreland 850' on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office (blow it with sticky bombs). The trophy pops after you escape the police — killing enemies is not needed. Not missable: if you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can go back for the rest.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

steps.t: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation before you go.
At Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn), take the luxury watch (south-east office), the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east corner table), and the safe (north-east hallway office, sticky bombs).
Escape the police — the trophy pops on the escape, not on the third item.
Missed one? Wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for the rest.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with BOTH Jason and Lucia at the same time. Available from Chapter 2 (Coffee Break), when you can switch characters. Work out at fitness clubs — always bring your partner (hold Right, press Triangle to call them): while you actively train with one character, the other completes their training automatically, doubling progress. Check strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon). You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

steps.t: After Coffee Break (Chapter 2), buy a fitness club membership and train with your partner alongside.
Always work out together — the inactive character trains automatically, doubling progress.
Track strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength; the trophy pops when both are at maximum.

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) — a demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. Profiles run Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes, destroying evidence), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (mass killing, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status to avoid, since cops shoot on sight. PowerPyx expects this to land passively while working on the other trophies and 100%; every robbery and enemy encounter counts. Check the count by clicking the trophy in the PSN list.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

steps.t: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On).
Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters count toward the 500.
Avoid the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.
If it is still short at the end, farm it — but expect it to pop passively first.

trophies.guide: Return to the Payday Loans store Lucia robs in the Prologue and rob the same store again as Lucia — then escape on foot. Earliest is after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer. Go to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City, alone as Lucia (without Jason): aim at the teller, take out security, break through the door and empty the 3 cash drawers, then run away on foot until the trophy pops. It only pops on foot, not in a vehicle, and the pop is delayed until you are clear of the police search area.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

steps.t: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
Go alone as Lucia to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, Vice City.
Rob it: aim at the teller, take out security, break through the door, empty the 3 cash drawers.
Escape ON FOOT — run clear of the police search area; driving away will not pop it.

trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. PowerPyx: go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back. By the blinking car, follow the path into the woods to the UFO (bright blue light in the sky); approach it and it drops an abducted woman. Talk to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside to pop the trophy. The spawn is slightly random. KeenGamer still lists this method as unconfirmed (see dispute D3).
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

steps.t: Go solo to the road north-west of Starlet Motel, Kelly County, at night after 2AM.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return.
Follow the path into the woods to the UFO, approach it, and talk to the woman it drops.
Offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside — the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds — a melee drive-by. PowerPyx's method: do it in crowded areas like Vice City or Ocean Beach. KeenGamer still lists the precise method as being confirmed (see dispute D4).
trophies.name: Ten Pin

steps.t: Get on any bike in a crowded area (Vice City or Ocean Beach).
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts — it counts across robberies, not in one haul. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most). Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this lands naturally while clearing the 8 vaults for 100%.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

steps.t: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then launder the marked bills at a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
Bank vaults (up to $205,000 each) make the $250,000 total arrive quickly.

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all shop types. Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos — the most expensive items. Leonida has 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores to spend it in.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

steps.t: Spend $100,000 in total across any shops — the total is cumulative.
Fastest: guns, car mods and tattoos — the priciest purchases.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 12 garages in total; 4 are story-related and do not count). They cost $160,000 together. Garages go on sale after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone — buy them through the app. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4, fund the purchases. Garages also add parking spots for On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

steps.t: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to unlock the Vice City Real Estate app.
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the app — $160,000 in total.
Fund them with robberies; Chapters 3–4 unlock the higher-value jobs.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app arrives after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses). You need enough garages first (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; in his garage choose 'Respray' then 'Register'. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot

steps.t: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app and Moses as a contact.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots to register vehicles into.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn; choose Respray, then Register.
Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep registration costs down.
